_note: Synthetic SRD-generic room for tools/kit_fuzz.py (no adventure text): a rubble-strewn vault with a visible magic brazier, a HIDDEN magic ring buried in the rubble, a hidden pressure-plate trap, hidden sigils behind a tapestry, a stuck oak door and a hidden skeleton guard.

vault.name: Rubble vault
vault.arrival: Someone picks their way in over the rubble.

cellar.name: Wine cellar
cellar.arrival: Someone comes down into the cellar.

labels.vault: A swollen oak door in the north wall.
labels.cellar: The oak door back up to the vault.

magic_objects.where: in the middle of the floor

brazier.text: An iron brazier burns with a cold blue flame in the middle of the floor.

handling.move: The brazier is too heavy to shift.

rubble.text: Broken masonry lies heaped in the south corner.

handling.look: Chunks of fallen ceiling, grey with dust.

magic_objects.where: buried under the rubble in the south corner

zircon_ring.text: A zircon signet ring lies buried under the rubble in the south corner.

handling.look: A pale stone in a silver band.

tapestry.text: A moth-eaten tapestry of a stag hunt hangs on the east wall.

handling.look: The stag's eye has been picked out of the weave.
handling.move: The tapestry sways on its rod.

sigils.text: Scorched warding sigils are cut into the stone behind the tapestry.

pressure_plate.text: A pressure plate under the threshold flagstone fires darts from the lintel.

barrels.text: Three empty wine barrels lie on their sides.

sigils.truth: Scorched warding sigils are cut behind the tapestry.

pressure_plate.truth: A pressure plate under the threshold arms a dart trap.

zircon_ring.truth: A zircon ring is buried in the rubble.

triggers.reveal: Bones rattle out of the rubble and a skeleton stands, sword first.
